video.title: AI欧腐《成为他宿敌的伴侣后，Alpha悔疯了/The Alpha Begged After I Became His Rival's Mate》
video.desc:
前期纯虐受的 有需要避雷的可以避哈
Winter, trusting brother Damon's vow of one true love, defies fate to bond with him and gives up the Alpha crown. Damon betrays him: he craves Winter's love, can't stay true, smothering him with money while cheating with his fated she-wolf mate. Winter cuts all ties and vanishes on the full moon.

Winter 相信了兄长 Damon "此生唯爱一人"的誓言，不惜违抗命运与他结契，甚至放弃了 Alpha 的王冠。Damon 却背叛了他：他贪恋 Winter 的爱，却做不到忠诚，一边用金钱将他淹没，一边与自己命定的母狼伴侣暗中偷情。Winter 斩断一切牵绊，在月圆之夜消失得无影无踪。
